Frequently asked questions

ElevenAgents runs across all voice and digital channels - telephony, web, mobile, WhatsApp, SMS, email, and chat - with native connectors for tools like Twilio, Genesys, Zendesk, and Salesforce. Embed the web widget with one line of HTML and manage every channel from a single place.

Agents speak 90+ languages and can switch between them mid-conversation. Choose from over 16,000 voices in our Voice Library, or clone and design your own to match your brand. Because we build our own voice models, your agent sounds natural and consistent in every market.

Most teams can configure there first agent within hours. For complex enterprise deployments, our forward-deployed engineers tend to help teams take their first agents to production within 2-3 months.

Yes. ElevenAgents is LLM agnostic - bring your own model, call a frontier model via API, or use our hosted, domain-tunable models. Connect your CRM, ticketing, calendar, and knowledge base, or reach any system through MCP, APIs, and webhooks. The platform is modular, so you adopt what you need and keep what already works.

We are SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS Level 1 certified, with HIPAA and GDPR compliance. Enterprise controls include Zero Retention Mode, data residency across the US, EU, and India, SSO, and granular access permissions. ElevenAgents is also the first agent platform eligible for AI insurance through AIUC, once certified. Review our full compliance overview at compliance.elevenlabs.io.

Most platforms stitch together voice synthesis, transcription, and reasoning models from multiple vendors. We take a research-first approach and build our own voice models in-house. As a result, ElevenAgents delivers very natural and expressive agent interactions. Our research and product teams work closely together, so customers get access to new AI capabilities first by choosing ElevenAgents. For your customers, that shows up as conversations that feel more human, resolve more issues on the first contact, and lift satisfaction across voice and chat.
